question: Aconcagua Oil & Extract manufacturer company
markdown:
Aconcagua Oil & Extract S.A.
is a private food production company based in
San Felipe, Valparaíso, Chile
. Specializing in the agricultural and culinary sector, the boutique manufacturer is best known for producing
Paltita
, an extra-virgin, cold-pressed avocado oil.
Company Overview
Headquarters:
San Felipe, Valparaíso Region, Chile.
Core Focus:
Food and beverage manufacturing, specifically cold-extracted plant oils.
Flagship Product:
Paltita
brand extra virgin avocado oil (additive-free, cholesterol-free, and rich in mono-unsaturated fats and vitamin E).
Company Size:
Micro-enterprise with approximately 2 to 10 employees.
Lusha
Industry Context
